recognize_zh: 全切片掃描圖：上方為具指狀絨毛皺摺的腸道黏膜與肌層，下方被一大團均質紫色的腫瘤取代並破壞腸壁，腫瘤內散布白色小點（星空樣巨噬細胞）；呈現結外腸道大腫塊型的侵襲性淋巴瘤。
features: Whole-mount section of bowel wall with intact mucosa and muscularis propria at one edge
Large, solid, homogeneous basophilic mass expanding beneath and through the bowel wall
Numerous tiny pale dots within the mass at low power, corresponding to a starry-sky pattern
Fine linear cracks and focal pale areas within the tumor; no obvious glandular or nested architecture
describe_en: A whole-slide low-power image shows a segment of bowel with intact mucosa and muscularis propria at one edge and a large, solid, homogeneously basophilic mass that expands the wall and extends deep to the muscularis. The tumor is diffusely cellular with numerous small pale dots distributed through it, corresponding to tingible-body macrophages. No glandular or nested epithelial architecture is identified within the mass. The low-power appearance is that of an extranodal gastrointestinal aggressive lymphoma; in this case the diagnosis of high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements depends on higher-power morphology, immunohistochemistry and FISH.

ddx.vs: Burkitt commonly presents as an ileocecal mass with an identical starry sky, but is BCL2-negative without BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: DLBCL has larger pleomorphic cells and lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.
Carcinoma arises from the mucosa with gland formation or cohesive nests and is keratin-positive.
